items.note: An outlined summary box at the top of the profile card says 'Fix 2 fields below'. The empty name field has the pink halo focus ring and the bad email has a red border, and each has a warning-icon message under it. The band, pill sub-nav and one pink save button with a ghost Reset stay in place.

Same error layout on the dark ground: the summary box has a red rule, the focused name field has a pink halo, and the email is outlined in red. The messages under the fields read clearly in light text, and the teal band keeps ink text.

One-column form. The red-bordered summary box sits above the photo row, and each invalid field has its own icon and message underneath. The pink save button and ghost Reset stay in the flow under the bio, and nothing is cut off.

After saving, an ink-bordered 'Saved' chip with a pink check sticker and a hard offset shadow appears next to Save changes and Reset. It is a small confirmation in the system's raised-card-with-hard-shadow language, and the form keeps the saved values.
The 'Saved' chip carries the light 35% hard shadow and the pink check on the dark card, so the confirmation stands out clearly beside the pink save button without competing with it.
The 'Saved' chip with its hard shadow wraps to its own line under the pink save button and ghost Reset, inside the card. The confirmation is clear and nothing overlaps.

A raised, ink-bordered dialog with a hard shadow asks 'Switch to the Business plan?', gives the price change in one sentence, and has a ghost Cancel and one pink 'Confirm change'. The scrim covers one viewport of the full-page capture, which is the expected look of a fixed layer.

The dark dialog panel has the light hard offset shadow, an outlined close button, a ghost Cancel and a pink confirm. The plan cards with their pink price tags dim behind the scrim, and the text stays readable.

On mobile the dialog fills the width over the scrim, with full-width stacked buttons: pink Confirm change on top and an outlined Cancel below. It keeps the ink border, the hard shadow and an outlined close square.

In the Change password card, a red-bordered summary says 'Fix 1 field'. The confirm field has the pink halo and a red border with 'Passwords do not match', a green check notes 'Strength: Strong', and the pink Update password button sits above the sessions table with its outlined Revoke actions.
Same mismatch state in dark: the pink-haloed confirm field, the red-ruled summary box and readable messages. The Revoke row actions keep their outline and their red icon.
One-column form with the summary box, field messages and pink update button in the flow. Below, the sessions table scrolls inside its bordered box, as the spec asks, rather than the page.
Keyboard focus sits on the selected 'Notifications' pill in the teal band and shows as a 2px ink outline offset around the raised pill. The switch cards below show ink switches for the on settings.
In dark, the focused sub-nav pill is ink-filled with a light outline ring that is clearly visible on the teal band. The switches are paper-on-ink and the toggle labels read well.

In the mobile pill strip, focus moved to 'Security'. Its outline shows only as two side arcs because the scrolling strip clips the ring's top and bottom, so the focused pill reads as bracketed rather than ringed.

findings.summary: On mobile, the horizontally scrolling pill strip clips the focus outline of a focused pill at the top and bottom. Only the two side arcs remain, so the ring doesn't read as a full ring. The spec gives the mobile strip no vertical padding or clearance rule for focus rings.
